## Fixed interpretation rule (plan §A), gated

Mechanical rule: replicates = pooled Δ CI (cluster) excludes 0 with the original's sign AND pooled Δ ≥ 50% of the original Δ. Gate (review item 1): the REPLICATES wording is only used when the original effect is ≥ 10 pp with a CI excluding 0; otherwise 'n/a (original effect < 10 pp)'. C6 spared = pooled C6 drop ≤ 5 pp AND CI upper bound of the drop ≤ 10 pp.

## Notes

- PRIMARY pooled CI = cluster bootstrap over the 306 contexts (orig_id), stratified by scheme (51 per scheme), 10k reps, RNG seed 0 (separate generator); each sampled context carries all 5 sets' outcomes.
- OPTIMISTIC pooled CI (kept for reference) = episodes resampled independently within set x scheme strata; it treats the 5 sets' copies of a context as independent and understates uncertainty.
- REPLICATES vocabulary is gated: only used when the original effect is >= 10 pp with a CI excluding 0; otherwise 'n/a (original effect < 10 pp)'. The mechanical rule outcome is reported in a separate column.
- The n=5 seed-level SD is indicative only: a 95% CI for an SD from 5 values is roughly [0.6, 2.9] x SD.
- About 150 uncorrected tests are run across the project; all p-values and CIs here are descriptive (no multiplicity correction); do not interpret |delta| < 5 pp or p > 1e-3 as evidence on their own.

Pooled bootstrap resamples episodes within set x scheme strata (30 strata of 51): sets are treated as fixed and episodes within a set as exchangeable. It does not treat the 5 sets as a random sample of sender seeds; seed-level variability is reported separately (SD/range of the 5 per-set Δ). The 5 sets share the same 306 episode contexts, so pooled episodes are not independent across sets.
